description: Reusable authored-pose direction for plague doctor player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies censer-and-compound choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: ominous, clinical, deliberate, and pendular, with beaked-mask focus, controlled censer arcs, protected compounds, and coat-led follow-through
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's beaked mask, dark coat, hat or hood, gloves, censer, bottles, satchel, and exact item count. Keep exactly one censer on its chain and one of each depicted compound; never unmask, duplicate, swap, or transform equipment.
identity.magicRule: Effects are controlled medicinal or toxic fumes from the established censer or one handled compound, using the portrait's palette. Keep clouds compact and translucent enough to show the mask, hands, chain, and body.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's covered face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, beaked mask, coat, hat or hood, gloves, censer, bottles, satchel, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact ominous silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered plague doctor in a clinical censer-ready stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall plague doctor motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, mask, coat, palette, proportions, censer, bottles, satchel, and chain continuity. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: An unsettling breathing loop makes small beaked-mask scans, controlled censer pendulum shifts, and protected satchel checks.
idle.effectRule: Only one thin contained wisp may rise from the established censer; no expanding cloud.

walk.motionDirection: A measured alternating stride uses real leg compression, controlled censer counter-swing, coat movement, and close-held compounds.
walk.effectRule: No active treatment or attack cloud; censer may retain one tiny vertical wisp.

attack.motionDirection: The chain shortens, shoulders coil, a planted step drives one controlled censer sweep, compact fumes mark contact, and the pendulum is arrested safely.
attack.effectRule: Use exactly one censer and one compact toxic or medicinal fume accent at contact; never duplicate the censer or hide the chain and body.

hurt.motionDirection: An impact snaps the coat and mask back, throws the censer outward on its retained chain, forces a low stagger, and resolves through careful containment.
hurt.effectRule: One compact impact and a few fume flecks are permitted; no gore, blood, unmasking, broken bottle, or lost censer.

death.motionDirection: A final impact stills the censer, knees fail beneath the coat, the masked body sinks and tips sideways, and all equipment settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Fumes fade without gore, blood, unmasking, explosion, rigid rotation, or duplicated equipment.

cast.motionDirection: The doctor stabilizes the censer, selects exactly one compound, adds it, raises the chain, guides a compact controlled cloud, then seals supplies and lowers the censer.
cast.effectRule: Create one compact translucent medicinal or toxic cloud from the censer and one selected compound; never duplicate items or obscure anatomy.

victory.effectRule: One thin celebratory fume spiral may rise from the censer; no large cloud, duplicated vial, or unmasking.
